title: Irving Berlin
creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
gloss: Biographical source: original name Israel Baline; born 11 May 1888; “the greatest and most enduring of American songwriters”; works including “Alexander’s Ragtime Band,” “God Bless America” and “White Christmas”; Academy Award 1943; died 22 September 1989.

title: Berlin, Irving
creator: Encyclopedia.com
gloss: Source for the immigration facts: the family fled Russian persecution of Jews and arrived in the United States in 1893, settling on Manhattan’s Lower East Side; the “I. Berlin” byline came from a 1907 printer’s error; Camp Upton and “Yip! Yip! Yaphank!” (1918); Kate Smith introduced “God Bless America” on 11 November 1938.
